UK Appeals Interpol to Reject Argentina's Falklands Oil Arrest Requests

The United Kingdom has appealed to Interpol to reject requests from the Argentine government, led by Javier Milei, for the arrest of individuals involved in an oil project near the Falkland Islands. Argentina's tribunal order requests are described by the UK as 'politically motivated'. The UK is urging caution over these requests, which target individuals linked to the oil project.
